title: Perspectives on Cross-Lingual Consistency in LLMs for Medical Questions

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting LLMs with country and professional personas to measure their preference for cultural adaptation versus cross-lingual consistency in medical answers, and comparing these response distributions to human stakeholder survey results.

Evaluating whether the language of the prompt (English, German, or Spanish) systematically shifts the model's default stance on medical question consistency versus adaptation, revealing a bias toward consistency when prompted in English.
